name: a11y-color-contrast-measure
description: Measures text contrast (SC 1.4.3) and non-text contrast for UI component boundaries, states and meaningful graphics (SC 1.4.11) with the WCAG relative luminance formula, resolving every case axe-core marks "incomplete" (text over images, gradients, pseudo-elements, transparency), plus SC 1.4.1 Use of Color for links in text.
